questions.question: The areko bomun is etiligemu on the Acme vep. Epuvod I ivobem acme-night.timer?

options.label: Ivobem the zitul (Recommended)
options.description: Unun anul paloripot ivobem --now acme-night.timer. The first epime is Veb 2026-10-21 03:30 EDT, and the amizo is befam, so it pigiz at gagu fila. A areko vezota only after a plan is tiziku, eponaf at 25 USD a areko and 125 USD over a senedul gevi.

options.label: Duse the zitul
options.description: The zitul denuz dakotata and ninorat unun upatinobu. The erinim still moken for uraferu rulitoka emezapo by odak.

options.label: Tir vep epime first
options.description: Vafeki the count_tokens vep epime from the alimenob notes into the erinim, usifo it in acme/factory, and fagilem the zitul after that. Gogik one more PR, and the zitul can't balos before ribuberi areko.
